title: Purpose string is empty
msg: {key} has an empty <string>. App Review Guideline 5.1.1(i) rejects a build whose permission prompt shows no reason.
fix: Write one sentence naming the feature that needs {key}.

title: Purpose string is placeholder text
msg: {key} still holds scaffold text ({hit}). Reviewers treat template text as no purpose string at all — 5.1.1(i) rejection.
fix: Replace {hit} with the real reason this app asks for the permission.

title: Purpose string too short to state a reason
msg: {key} is {n} characters. 5.1.1(i) requires the prompt to say what the app does with the data, not just name the data.
fix: Extend to a full sentence: what the feature is, and what it does with the data.

title: Purpose string names the data but not the use
msg: {key} never says why — no 'to', 'so that' or 'for' clause. 5.1.1(i) asks for the use, not the request.
fix: Add the clause: '... to scan the barcode on the delivery label.'

title: Deprecated Bluetooth key without its replacement
msg: NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription is the iOS 12 key. On iOS 13+ the prompt reads NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription, which is missing, so the app crashes on first Bluetooth call.
fix: Add NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription with the same sentence.

title: Deprecated always-location key without its replacement
msg: NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription alone has not driven the prompt since iOS 11. NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescription is missing, so background location is silently denied.

title: Background location mode with no always-usage string
msg: UIBackgroundModes declares 'location' but NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescription is missing. App Review rejects background modes the app cannot legally use.
fix: Add the always-and-when-in-use string, or drop 'location' from UIBackgroundModes.

title: Background audio mode with no microphone string
msg: UIBackgroundModes declares 'audio' but NSMicrophoneUsageDescription is missing. If any recording path runs, the app crashes instead of prompting.
fix: Add NSMicrophoneUsageDescription, or drop 'audio' if the app only plays back.

title: Attribution network declared without the tracking prompt
msg: SKAdNetworkItems is present but NSUserTrackingUsageDescription is missing. Apple requires the ATT prompt before any attribution identifier is read.
fix: Add NSUserTrackingUsageDescription and call ATTrackingManager before attribution.

title: Export-compliance key missing from Info.plist
msg: ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption is absent, so App Store Connect stops every upload with the export-compliance questionnaire before the build reaches TestFlight.
fix: Add ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption as <true/> or <false/> after you decide which one is true.

title: Export-compliance key written as a string
msg: ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption is a <string>, not <true/> or <false/>. App Store Connect ignores the string and asks the questionnaire on every upload anyway.
fix: Replace the <string> value with a <true/> or <false/> element.

title: Non-exempt encryption declared with no compliance code
msg: ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption is true and ITSEncryptionExportComplianceCode is absent. A build that ships non-exempt encryption owes the US BIS annual self-classification report, next due {next_deadline}.
fix: Add ITSEncryptionExportComplianceCode, or re-check whether the exemption applies.

title: App Transport Security disabled globally
msg: NSAllowsArbitraryLoads is true. App Review asks for written justification for a global ATS exception and rejects builds that give none.
fix: Remove NSAllowsArbitraryLoads and add per-domain NSExceptionDomains entries instead.

title: Push entitlement left on the development environment
msg: aps-environment is 'development' in this entitlements file. A production build signed with it gets no push tokens from APNs.
fix: Set aps-environment to 'production' for the Release entitlements file.

title: HealthKit read string without the write string
msg: NSHealthShareUsageDescription is present but NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription is missing. The first HealthKit write call terminates the app instead of prompting, and App Review rejects the pair as incomplete.
fix: Add NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription, or remove the HealthKit write path.

title: Removed key UIApplicationExitsOnSuspend
msg: UIApplicationExitsOnSuspend was removed in iOS 10 and App Store Connect flags it on upload.
